question: Four pairs of letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/130e026a7c3720f6f9db70163ea219cbcf01f13f419b49f6b5b6c1ad7f909510.png] 

The logic followed here is: 

1) GLT : LSY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e9d66cec7f8bc960726571ba33e97ba83a1731ea745453bf614b3d97ea170b3.png] 

2) MJR : RQW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9878bd5f621777750eb783af49a9809faa201a0791909c2a42da78603ca711ea.png] 

**3) CBJ : HIN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28382bff9b3a17a0e2ca661e114b7376ec9e762370574a9841f804e101b256da.png] 

4) FDL : KKQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a804df5b951127d0891353575727a046d39386bf777d2bf66a12bdeca50f8dca.png] 

Clearly, 'CBJ : HIN' does not follow the same logic that is being followed by the other options thus it is different.

Hence, the correct answer is "CBJ : HIN".
